clue.text: Professional and devout person, highly thought of, completely overcome

parts.note: a pro is a professional
a saint is a devout person, abbreviated ST
something highly rated is highly thought of

explanation.surface: A churchgoing professional, much admired, is overwhelmed by something.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone laid low by grief or exhaustion is said to be prostrated, utterly overwhelmed.

clue.text: The old man, looking embarrassed, shaved

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father, 'the old man'
an embarrassed person goes red in the face

explanation.surface: Dad, red-faced, has had a shave.
explanation.definitionFit: To pare is to trim or shave off a thin layer, so pared means shaved.

clue.text: No longer in the groove musically and not to be talked about

definitions.text: No longer in the groove musically
definitions.meaning: a stylus lifted from a gramophone disc is no longer in its groove
remarks made confidentially, not for repeating

explanation.surface: Something out of musical form is also a secret.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally, a needle lifted from a disc; idiomatically, said in confidence and not for publication.

clue.text: Legendary marksman's order

definitions.meaning: William ..., the Swiss hero who shot an apple off his son's head
to ... someone to do something is to order them

explanation.surface: A command given by a famous legendary archer.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is read as 'is', linking the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: William Tell is the legendary crossbowman; to tell is also to instruct or command.

clue.text: Agreement as communicated

parts.note: a message communicated has been sent

explanation.surface: Agreement, as it was passed on to others.
explanation.definitionFit: Assent is consent or agreement to a proposal.

clue.text: Former hospital worker becoming international trader

parts.note: ex- means former
a porter moves patients and equipment around a hospital

explanation.surface: An ex-hospital porter has gone into overseas business.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm that sells goods abroad is a trader working internationally.

clue.text: Terminology set out in lecture on Man

indicators.note: letters set out afresh are laid out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Technical vocabulary is laid out in a lecture about humanity.
explanation.definitionFit: Nomenclature is the system of names or terms used in a field.

clue.text: Intellectual fellows converse endlessly

parts.note: fellows are men

indicators.note: endlessly means the final letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to converse is to talk

explanation.surface: Clever men chatter on and on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' trims the K from TALK, leaving TAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Mental means relating to the mind or intellect, a synonym of intellectual.

clue.text: Fictional thief in gambling enterprises

definitions.meaning: A. J. ..., E. W. Hornung's gentleman cat burglar
lotteries where tickets are drawn for prizes

explanation.surface: A storybook burglar involved in betting schemes.
explanation.definitionFit: Raffles is Hornung's gentleman burglar; raffles are also prize draws, a form of gambling.

clue.text: Page by girl, not poetic writing

parts.note: Rose is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A page written by a girl is not verse.
explanation.definitionFit: Prose is ordinary written language as opposed to verse.

clue.text: Boy bowled over having got hold of hard author

indicators.note: the turned word holds another letter inside it
knocked over, so the word for boy is turned the other way round

parts.note: a lad is a boy
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A boy knocked down after clinging to a tough writer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bowled over' turns LAD into DAL; 'having got hold of' puts H inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Roald Dahl wrote Charlie and the Chocolate Factory and other books.

clue.text: Great sin could make you most irate

indicators.note: the letters could be remade into a new word, signalling rearrangement

explanation.surface: A great sin would make you furious.
explanation.definitionFit: Irate means angry, so the most irate is the most angry, a superlative synonym.

clue.text: Get a tube made specially for lunch in France?

indicators.note: specially made means put together in a new form

explanation.surface: Fetching a custom-made tube for a meal in France.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks a definition by example: a French loaf is one typical lunch there.
explanation.definitionFit: The long French stick loaf is a staple of a French lunch, an example rather than a synonym.

clue.text: Female occupying barn or mansion

indicators.note: the name occupies, sits inside, the words that follow

explanation.surface: A woman living in a barn or a stately home.
explanation.definitionFit: Norma is a woman's name, so it is an example of a female.

clue.text: Number I catch being smuggled into US city

indicators.note: slipped inside, so these letters go within the city's abbreviation

parts.note: NY is New York
to net is to catch

explanation.surface: A haul being smuggled into an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Ninety is a number, ten more than eighty.

clue.text: Do well reading out two letters

indicators.note: saying the letters as spoken signals a sound-alike

parts.note: the letters X and L

explanation.surface: Performing well by reading aloud two letters of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: To excel is to be outstanding or do very well.

clue.text: Puzzle in game to be worked out

indicators.note: worked out suggests the letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A puzzle in a game waiting to be solved.
explanation.definitionFit: An enigma is a mystery or riddle, something puzzling.

clue.text: Piece of music? Criticise performance in the auditorium

indicators.note: an auditorium is where audiences hear things, so the words are taken as heard

parts.note: knock means criticise and turn means a performance, as in a variety act

explanation.surface: Panning an act from the stalls of a concert hall.
explanation.definitionFit: A nocturne is a dreamy night-piece, as in Chopin's nocturnes, a musical composition.

clue.text: One past Shakespearean villain

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
ago means in the past

explanation.surface: A wicked character from Shakespeare's past.
explanation.definitionFit: Iago is the scheming villain of Othello.

clue.text: Open a series of deliveries arriving on time

parts.note: in cricket an over is six balls bowled in succession

explanation.surface: Open parcels arriving punctually on a delivery round.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled from one end.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means open and unconcealed, the opposite of covert.

clue.text: Passage cut off at one end — it is surrounded by water

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is removed

parts.note: an aisle is a passage between seats

explanation.surface: A corridor blocked at one end has water all round it.
explanation.definitionFit: An island is land surrounded by water, and isle is a poetic word for one.

clue.text: Jack obtained, not good card

parts.note: jack and tar are both slang for a sailor

indicators.note: not tells us to remove the following letter

parts.note: got means obtained

explanation.surface: A jack was drawn, which is not a good card.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes G from GOT, leaving OT.
explanation.definitionFit: A tarot is one of the cards in a fortune-telling pack.

clue.text: Greet us, somehow giving signal

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters are rearranged in some way

explanation.surface: Welcome us by somehow waving.
explanation.definitionFit: A gesture is a movement of the hand made as a signal.

clue.text: Men's debate rambling: a lowering of quality

indicators.note: a rambling debate wanders all over, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A meandering men's discussion drags standards down.
explanation.definitionFit: To debase is to degrade, so debasement is the reduction of value or standard.
